[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Annette Miran''' was an officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and a chief researcher of the [[Applied Toxicology]] Division. She was an acting liaison to [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during an [[CI-004 Incident|incident]] at their [[CI-004 Research Facility]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=operation|Nature of Progress}}</ref>
